# Statistical Translation

> IBM Model 1 and Model 2 word alignment, built from scratch: expectation-maximization training, position-dependent alignment, and alignment-error-rate evaluation.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation

## Source

- [src/statistical_translation/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/__init__.py): Statistical Translation - IBM Model 1 and 2 word alignment from scratch.
- [src/statistical_translation/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/cli.py): Command line interface for the statistical translation aligner.
- [src/statistical_translation/corpus.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/corpus.py): Types for a parallel corpus of sentence pairs.
- [src/statistical_translation/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/data.py): A bundled parallel corpus with gold word alignments for evaluation.
- [src/statistical_translation/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/evaluation.py): Alignment Error Rate evaluation for word alignment models.
- [src/statistical_translation/ibm1.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/ibm1.py): IBM Model 1 word alignment, trained with expectation-maximization.
- [src/statistical_translation/ibm2.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/ibm2.py): IBM Model 2 word alignment, trained with expectation-maximization.
- [src/statistical_translation/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/statistical_translation/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/statistical-translation/blob/main/src/statistical_translation/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained alignment models.
